claude_proposed_widenings.name: ApplyConditionEffect in Effect union
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The save_gate onFail outcome is condition application (Charmed + Incapacitated + Speed 0). The Effect union currently only has DamageEffect and NoneEffect. apply_condition is a v4 atom but is not a variant of the spell Effect type, making any honest activation encoding impossible.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature in the area who can see the pattern must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition expansion beyond 'prone'
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type is currently limited to 'prone'. Hypnotic Pattern applies 'charmed' and 'incapacitated'. These are both core SRD conditions with deterministic mechanical consequences and are required for honest apply_condition encoding.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...or have the Charmed condition for the duration. While Charmed, the creature has the Incapacitated condition...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Compound multi-condition effect (apply_conditions list)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Hypnotic Pattern applies two conditions simultaneously (Charmed and Incapacitated) from a single save failure, plus a Speed modifier. A single apply_condition atom covers one condition; the surface needs a way to express compound condition application or multiple effects from one save branch.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While Charmed, the creature has the Incapacitated condition and a Speed of 0.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_taken self-break in Duration or lifecycle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends per-target when the target takes damage. This is a self_break triggered by a damage event, not a timed expire. The v4 self_break lifecycle atom exists but the Duration type and lifecycle surface shapes have no variant for damage-triggered per-target breaks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: action_break by third party in Duration or lifecycle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell also ends per-target when any other creature uses their Action to shake the affected creature. This is a specific 'action expenditure by any creature targeting the affected creature' break, distinct from the caster dismissing concentration. No current surface shape covers this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
